name: Puzzle Dog
source: user-provided ChatGPT-generated character sheet, chosen by Benjamin over an earlier from-scratch alternative and over a competing fox-mascot concept from the same batch
provenance_note: These stills originated outside the local ComfyUI pipeline (external tool, not run by this agent). Reused here as identity/style reference per Benjamin's explicit choice, same treatment as the already-real DownloadThat logo/screenshot assets. All motion synthesis (I2V) from these stills is still 100% local LTX-2.3 per AGENTS.md — only the character-design stills are externally sourced, not the video generation.

superseded.what: An earlier from-scratch local SDXL-Turbo teal/cyan+yellow mascot, generated and briefly locked before the ChatGPT batch arrived
superseded.files: ComfyUI output/downloadthat/ad07/mascot_front_v1-v4*.png, mascot_phone_pose*.png (left in place, not deleted, per AGENTS.md no-delete-ungefragt rule)

design.concept: small dog-like creature, entire body built from visible interlocking jigsaw-puzzle-piece segments
design.body_color: blue (#2B5B8C-ish mid blue, sampled from sheet)
design.personality: clever, relaxed, slightly smug, confident dry comic timing (matches brief §7)

brand_system_from_sheet.ui_style_notes: deep dark surfaces with soft glow accents, rounded corners, neumorphism, gradient CTAs
brand_system_from_sheet.note: This palette/typography is the mascot-sheet's own brand-concept exploration, not necessarily the shipped app's real UI (compare store_assets/screenshot_main.png, which uses a magenta-on-off-white style). Used here for storyboard mascot-side art direction only; real app screenshots (see manifests/brand_assets.json) are composited as-is wherever the literal app UI must appear on screen, per brief §10/§19.
